# Ultra-lightweight independent monthly pulse for Slot 67 (12-Major Dynamic Anti-Hegemon AI).
# Rebel-guarded per fx17; runs the global O(1) scan at most ONCE per calendar month (global_var:oe_heg_ai_ran_m),
# plus a single O(1) self-check for any non-major human empire (var:oe_heg_ai_hum_m).
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_heg_ai_fallback_pulse } }

oe_heg_ai_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            NOT = { global_var:oe_heg_ai_ran_m ?= oe_heg_ai_m_now }
            AND = {
                is_ai = no
                is_subject = no
                NOT = { var:oe_heg_ai_hum_m ?= oe_heg_ai_m_now }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_heg_ai_monthly = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_ai = no
                is_subject = no
                NOT = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_off = yes }
                NOT = { var:oe_heg_ai_hum_m ?= oe_heg_ai_m_now }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_hum_m value = oe_heg_ai_m_now }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_heg_ai_test_force ?= 1 } }
                oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
